answer: Edge case one: a link signed during a reorg. Store every web-of-trust edge in escrow until finality, then release it with the block height attached. Edge case two: recursive self-audit. Bar any identity from auditing its own recruit, since that edge is where farms hide. Edge case three: silence. Decay an edge when neither side signs in an epoch, which is how a basalt ring erodes. A gale of signatures costs a farm nothing; escrowed finality plus a reef of independent auditors costs it a bond per edge.
